objective_value: <float> Total cost combining first-echelon travel cost, satellite handling cost, and second-echelon travel cost.

first_echelon_routes.vehicle: <int> Identifier of the first-echelon vehicle performing this tour.
first_echelon_routes.route: <list[int], length variable> Ordered sequence of node ids visited by the first-echelon vehicle, starting and ending at the depot.
first_echelon_routes.deliveries: <dict, key: '{satellite_id}'> Quantity of freight delivered by this first-echelon vehicle to each satellite it visits.

second_echelon_routes.satellite: <int> Identifier of the satellite from which this second-echelon vehicle departs and returns.
second_echelon_routes.route: <list[int], length variable> Ordered sequence of node ids visited by the second-echelon vehicle, starting and ending at the originating satellite.

group_assignments: <dict, key: '{group_id}'> Satellite identifier to which each customer group is assigned for second-echelon service.
